features.title: Elemental magic
features.text: Use magical impulses instead of spell slots. Your chosen elements and feats can specialize in area damage, healing, protection or movement; you cannot excel at everything at once.

features.title: A repeating toolkit
features.text: Impulses are repeatable, subject to their own limits. Manage your aura and stances, and reopen the aura after an overflow impulse. Elemental Blast is one option among many.

review.notes: Editorial assessment of the class framework and ordinary builds. Rules references support mechanics; scores remain judgments.

ratings.offense: 3–4 → 2.5–5. Offensive fire and area-impulse builds can reach the top band; defensive or healing selections do not.
ratings.defense: 2.5–4 → 2.5–5. Earth and wood protection choices can create exceptional durability; other elements invest elsewhere.
ratings.support: 2–4.5 → 2–5. Water healing, wood protection and control impulses can specialize in support.
ratings.utility: 3–4.5 → 2–4. Air movement and chosen impulses solve particular problems, with less breadth than a full spell collection.
ratings.difficulty: 3.5 → 3.5. Choose synergistic impulses and manage aura, stances and overflow; no daily spell slots.
